text: Three plans stand between architecture and go-live: what financial data actually migrates, who gets access to what, and the exact sequence Stonefield follows the week it cuts over.
Only open AP and AR balances move over via FBDI, as of the cutover date -- not the legacy system's full transaction history.
Security gets planned around real teams: Arjun Mehta's AP team, Felicity Dunmore's AR and Collections team, and Simone Alvarez's broader close and general ledger access.
The cutover sequence ends in a UAT pass -- real sample transactions, checked for completeness and correct totals, before the wider team goes live.
Next: opening Oracle Fusion Setup for real, and building the actual chart of accounts and enterprise structure.
